## Pinned Open-Source Repositories
- `https://github.com/NullAITech/zoth-studio-v2` — Zoth Studio v2 (`npx @nullaitech/zoth studio`): 77 free open-access tools (55 in-browser + 22 CLI/daemon, with 74 public GitHub repositories), 21-Agent Pantheon, and Adytum 22 Tarot planner.
- `https://github.com/NullAITech/zoth-os` — ZothOS v3.4.0 Debian 13 (Trixie) Live OS with KDE Plasma 6, 77 CLI tools, Sovereign Agent Bridge (`:8102`), and Neuro-Memory (`:8094`).
- `https://github.com/1nc0gn30/zothos-lite` — ZothOS-Lite v1.2 Tails-style Amnesic Monotone RAM-only (`toram`) OS & portable ISO supporting 48+ models across 8 providers, interactive onboarding wizard, ZothNet P2P mesh, and external USB/cloud drive persistence.
- `https://github.com/1nc0gn30/chain-of-thoughts` — Chain of Thoughts (`zoth-cot`) 6-phase dialectical reasoning CLI & MCP server.
- `https://github.com/1nc0gn30/hermes-zoth` — Hermes-Zoth multi-agent orchestrator & plugin for Nous Hermes Agent.
- `https://github.com/1nc0gn30/zoth-ascii-magic` — Sub-pixel Unicode U+2800 Braille, Ordered Bayer 4×4/8×8 dither, and Sobel edge-aware TrueColor ASCII shader engine.
